message: The other day, I was in the middle of a family get-together when my phone decided to die. Just when I wanted to pull up that recipe I was sure would impress everyone! After a few chuckles and some improvised cooking, I realized how important it is to have a backup plan. It’s not just about food; I like to keep important documents and contacts written down too, just in case tech plays tricks on us. It’s a gentle reminder that sometimes the simplest preparations can save the day. Have you ever had a tech mishap like that?
